description: Get the latest-day net ETF inflow/outflow (USD millions) for every tracked crypto asset: BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ethereum), SOL (Solana), XRP, HYP (Hyperliquid), DOGE (Dogecoin), LINK (Chainlink), AVAX (Avalanche), HBAR (Hedera), LTC (Litecoin), BNB, DOT (Polkadot), SUI, NEAR, TRX (TRON) and ZEC (Zcash). Positive = inflow, negative = outflow. Flows are published one business day in arrears, so `referenceIsToday` is normally false: the figures belong to `referenceDate`, the last trading day published, not to the current date. On Mondays the freshest data is Friday's. `totalUsdM` is the sum across all assets for `referenceDate`. `netFlowUsdM` is null for an asset that has no figure for `referenceDate` yet; its latest reported day is then in `lastReportedDate`, and it is not part of `totalUsdM`. Figures are asset-level totals; the per-fund breakdown (IBIT, FBTC, ETHA and others) is returned by get_fund_flows, net assets by get_funds.
name: get_flows_summary
title: Latest Crypto ETF Flows
